Right-biased U.S. news outlets focus on risks related to the false portrayal of historical figures and biases in content moderation systems, such as how negative comments about women are more likely to be flagged as hateful compared to similar comments about men. They frame these issues in a way that aligns with their agenda, emphasizing concerns about perceived discrimination against conservative viewpoints.

In contrast, left-biased outlets report on risks associated with the inclusion of far-right and non-reputable sources in AI training data, which they argue leads to the dissemination of hate speech. They also highlight the negative impacts of AI technologies on marginalized groups, such as financial discrimination against people of color.

Both sides use politicized language in their reporting, reflecting their respective political agendas and concerns.
